transcript.text: If I had to 4x sales in a business and I
wasn't allowed to change the ads, I
wasn't allowed to change the sales
script, I wasn't allowed to change the
offer, there's one thing that just about
every business can do that they aren't
doing because it's hard, which is you
can respond to leads the moment they opt
in and hold on. So, HubSpot did a study
and tracked how your response time after
lead opt in affects your actual getting
in touch with them and talking to them.
And so, they did a group A version where
they contacted them 30 minutes after
opting in. And then group B, 5 minutes
after they opted in. Group B was a 100
times 100 times more likely to contact
the lead. And so, that is how you
increase revenue by 4x is that you make
the leads that you have, which you
currently think are actually great
because you give yourself a real shot at
talking to them. Because the reality is
that someone has a huge motivation for a
tiny period of time and we need to be
there in that moment.
